newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Petroz says Border-1 well unsuccessful.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Petroz says Border-1 well unsuccessful.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Petroz NL said on Wednesday the Border-1 well in the Carnarvon Basin offshore Western Australia was being plugged and abandoned after failing to find hydrocarbons.
The well was drilled to a total depth of 935 metres.
Petroz said it would earn a 20 percent interest in Permit EP399 and adjoining permit EP400 by contributing to part of the cost of drilling the well by operator Ampolex Ltd, a unit of Mobil Corp.
Ampolex has a 65 percent interest, subject to the farmout agreement with Petroz, Clyde Expro Plc has 20 percent and Tap Oil NL 15 percent.
